harnessSource:
"""Rule-6 mutants for syzygy-bpyt.8.3. The change removes the wait-mode sign-off gate and adds no check, so each mutant puts a refusal
back at one of the three sites the gate held (await, session-prompt all, delivery to a waiting reviewer) and asks whether the
wait-mode suites still notice a refusal there. G1-G3 refuse unconditionally; G4 refuses only when the v1.2 sign-off record is absent
from the records root, as the removed gate would have for that one input.

Each mutant replaces one exact fragment (it must occur exactly once), runs the suites in their own process group with vitest's JSON
reporter, restores the bytes and verifies their digest. Killed: at least one test failed, or the run did not finish within the
timeout. Each failed test is stored with the first line of its first failure message.
Usage: python3 mutants.py <worktree> <scratch> <out.json>
"""
import hashlib, json, os, signal, subprocess, sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT, SCRATCH, OUT = Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve(), Path(sys.argv[2]).resolve(), Path(sys.argv[3])
TIMEOUT = 600
WAIT = 'packages/polaris-dossier/src/waiting-sessions.ts'
HANDOVER = 'packages/polaris-dossier/src/session-handover.ts'
TESTS = ['packages/polaris-dossier/src/waiting-sessions.test.ts', 'packages/polaris-dossier/src/session-view.test.ts',
         'packages/polaris-dossier/src/agent-texts.test.ts']
REPORT = SCRATCH / 'mutant-vitest.json'
COMMAND = ['npx', 'vitest', 'run', '--project', '@syzygy/polaris-dossier', '--reporter=json', f'--outputFile={REPORT}', *TESTS]

AWAIT_AT = 'disclosures: AWAIT_DISCLOSURES } });\n  // The directory: absolute'
START_AT = 'disclosures: START_DISCLOSURES } });\n  const opened = await openRun(runDir'
DELIVER_AT = 'disclosures: DELIVERY_DISCLOSURES } });\n  if (request.tool !== undefined'
RECORD = "'.syzygy/governance/decisions/POLARIS-DOSSIER-LOCAL-AGENT-MODE-SIGNOFF-v1.2.md'"


def plant(at, line):
    head, tail = at.split('\n', 1)
    return head + '\n' + line + '\n' + tail


MUTANTS = [
    ('G1-await-refuses', WAIT, AWAIT_AT, plant(AWAIT_AT, "  return refuse('unsigned', 'mutant G1');")),
    ('G2-session-prompt-all-refuses', HANDOVER, START_AT, plant(START_AT, "  return refuse('unsigned', 'mutant G2');")),
    ('G3-delivery-refuses', HANDOVER, DELIVER_AT, plant(DELIVER_AT, "  return refuse('unsigned', 'mutant G3');")),
    ('G4-await-refuses-without-the-v1.2-record', WAIT, AWAIT_AT,
     plant(AWAIT_AT, f"  if (!fs.existsSync(path.join(deps.sources.recordsRoot, {RECORD}))) return refuse('unsigned', 'mutant G4');")),
]


def sha(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def git(*args):
    return subprocess.run(['git', '-C', str(ROOT), *args], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout


def run_suite():
    REPORT.unlink(missing_ok=True)
    proc = subprocess.Popen(COMMAND, cwd=ROOT, env={**os.environ, 'CI': '1'}, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, start_new_session=True)
    try:
        proc.communicate(timeout=TIMEOUT)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        os.killpg(proc.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
        proc.communicate()
        return None, None, []
    if not REPORT.exists():
        return proc.returncode, None, []
    report = json.loads(REPORT.read_text())
    failed = [{'test': f"{Path(file['name']).name} > {test['fullName']}",
               'firstErrorLine': next((line for message in test['failureMessages'] for line in message.splitlines() if line.strip()), None)}
              for file in report['testResults'] for test in file['assertionResults'] if test['status'] == 'failed']
    counts = {k: report[k] for k in ('numTotalTests', 'numPassedTests', 'numFailedTests', 'numPendingTests', 'numTodoTests')}
    return proc.returncode, counts, failed


def main():
    subjects = sorted({m[1] for m in MUTANTS})
    originals = {f: (ROOT / f).read_bytes() for f in subjects}
    for f in subjects:
        text = originals[f].decode('utf8')
        assert "import * as fs from 'node:fs';" in text or f != WAIT, 'G4 needs fs in waiting-sessions.ts'
    clean_before = git('status', '--porcelain', '--untracked-files=no') == ''
    base_exit, base_counts, base_failed = run_suite()
    results = []
    try:
        for mutant_id, file, old, new in MUTANTS:
            text = originals[file].decode('utf8')
            assert text.count(old) == 1, (mutant_id, old)
            (ROOT / file).write_bytes(text.replace(old, new).encode('utf8'))
            try:
                code, counts, failed = run_suite()
            finally:
                (ROOT / file).write_bytes(originals[file])
            blocked = code is None
            results.append({'id': mutant_id, 'file': file, 'old': old, 'new': new, 'exitCode': code, 'counts': counts,
                            'failedTests': failed, 'blocked': blocked,
                            'outcome': 'killed' if blocked or (code != 0 and failed) else 'survived',
                            'restored': sha((ROOT / file).read_bytes()) == sha(originals[file])})
            print(mutant_id, results[-1]['outcome'], counts, flush=True)
    finally:
        for file in subjects:
            (ROOT / file).write_bytes(originals[file])
    record = {
        'title': 'syzygy-bpyt.8.3 rule-6 mutants: a refusal put back at each site the wait-mode sign-off gate held',
        'bead': 'syzygy-bpyt.8.3', 'subject': subjects, 'subjectSha256': {f: sha(originals[f]) for f in subjects},
        'commit': git('rev-parse', 'HEAD').strip(), 'command': ' '.join(COMMAND).replace(str(REPORT), '<scratch>/mutant-vitest.json'),
        'timeoutSeconds': TIMEOUT, 'trackedTreeCleanBefore': clean_before,
        'unmutated': {'exitCode': base_exit, 'counts': base_counts, 'failedTests': base_failed},
        'mutants': results, 'trackedTreeCleanAfter': git('status', '--porcelain', '--untracked-files=no') == '',
        'summary': {'planned': len(MUTANTS), 'killed': sum(r['outcome'] == 'killed' for r in results),
                    'survived': [r['id'] for r in results if r['outcome'] == 'survived'], 'allRestored': all(r['restored'] for r in results)},
        'harnessSource': Path(__file__).read_text(),
    }
    OUT.write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n')
    print('summary', record['summary'])


main()
